title: ArtProvenance
description: Compliance and reproducibility record for one generated cover-art artifact. Ships in the delivery package (COVER_DESIGN.md §9) — retailers require AI-content disclosure, and this is the answer.

providerSlug.description: The RESOLVED serving provider — required because allow_fallbacks is always false, so this is exact, never a guess

artBriefHash.description: Hash of the ArtBrief that produced this image — the provenance chain's link back to the brief. Distinct from imageHash.

imageHash.description: CAS hash of the generated image itself.

sampleUsed.description: Whether cover-brief consumed an opt-in manuscript excerpt. Never the excerpt itself.
